Wordami image meaning audit · 2026-11-26

672 vocabulary images + 23 portraits visually inspected. No referenced raster files are missing.

Initial assistant visual inspection of all 653 vocabulary images and 23 portraits, joined to both language packs. Replacements reviewed at 112px/light and 56px/dark; 65 corrected mappings, personalization, café flows, map geometry, media, recording, resume, offline loading and progress preservation verified locally. Historical source findings and rejected masters are preserved.

47 recorded findings; 47 addressed through reviewed replacements, precise diagrams, mapping corrections and runtime fixes. 51 new assets reviewed; 7 supplementary scene/personalized assets. Pending: {}.

Meaning checks include singular/plural counts, sleeping/awake actions, food/animal senses, time of day, gestures, contrast pairs and all cross-language reuse. Existing historical approval records were not changed.

  • Current local checkout, not the deployed site.
  • All current vocabulary raster mappings and named/default portraits were inspected; decorative branding, selectable avatar variants and unused historic assets are outside the word/phrase audit.
  • Text tiles and text-only cards are inventoried separately, not counted as illustrations. No picture is not automatically a defect, especially for abstract advanced sentences.
  • No-obvious-mismatch means no contradiction seen at contact-sheet size; it does not certify that a picture uniquely expresses every grammatical distinction or every personalized variant.
  • Replacement assets have separate assistant review records and hashes. Release 3.133/build 205 deployment status is tracked in GitHub Actions.

Reproduce: node tools/audit_image_inventory.js, then G:/Python/python.exe tools/render_semantic_audit.py, then G:/Python/python.exe tools/build_semantic_audit_report.py. Running these tools does not perform or renew human review.

New interactive image briefs

  • free-seat (integrated-and-verified): One visibly empty wooden café chair pulled out from a small round table; a coffee cup at the neighbouring occupied place, suitable for Rūta's cv1 scene. Transparent background; complete silhouette; no text.
  • cafe-counter (integrated-and-verified): Café counter with till, pastries and a queue of three people seen from behind; unmistakably busy. Transparent background; broad shapes readable at mobile size; no text.
  • cafe-empty-table (integrated-and-verified): Small café table with an empty place setting and no drink, food or bill; neutral pre-choice state. Transparent background.
  • cafe-empty-cup (integrated-and-verified): The selected café drink's cup after use: visibly empty, on its saucer, without steam. Use separate coffee/tea variants if their vessel silhouettes differ.
  • cafe-bill (integrated-and-verified): Standalone café bill on a small tray. Blank broad receipt lines; exact totals supplied by the app if needed. No person already paying.
  • cafe-payment-terminal (integrated-and-verified): Standalone card terminal with an obvious contactless symbol and separate bank card. Neutral waiting state, no success tick before the learner asks to pay.
